name: Bayesian personalized ranking loss
description: Pairwise implicit-ranking softplus(negative_score-positive_score); sampling is external.

examples.title: Train matrix factorization with BPR
examples.code:
import tempfile
import torch
from topologies import Trainer, build, synth
root = tempfile.mkdtemp()
@synth.generator
def pairs(ctx):
 user = int(torch.randint(0, 8, (), generator=ctx.rng.torch))
 positive = int(torch.randint(0, 12, (), generator=ctx.rng.torch))
 negative = (positive + 1) % 12
 return {"users": user, "positive_items": positive, "negative_items": negative}
ds = synth.Spec("bpr-ranking", generator=pairs, size=24, splits={"train": 0.75, "val": 0.25}, seed=11, root=root, monitor="none").run()
train = ds.for_recipe("recommender-bpr", split="train")
model = build("matrix-factorization", "tiny", num_users=8, num_items=12, embedding_dim=4)
trainer = Trainer(model, train, recipe="recommender-bpr", recipe_config={"loss": "bpr"}, max_epochs=1, device="cpu")
trainer.fit()

parameters.reduction: none per pair, mean, or sum
